name: WorshipFlow AI
shortDescription: A UK-operated Planning Center companion that matches sermon themes to a church song catalogue, prepares rehearsal briefs and generates worship-team resources.
suitableContexts: Churches already using Planning Center Services
Worship teams matching a sermon theme to an existing song catalogue
Teams that want rehearsal briefs adjusted for scheduled musicians and singers

pricing.summary: WorshipFlow AI publishes GBP monthly plans at £12 for up to 40 Planning Center volunteers, £29 for up to 150 and £59 for unlimited volunteers. The supplier advertises a 14-day no-card trial and a Founding Member pilot for its first 10 production churches; confirm live availability, VAT and renewal terms before purchase.

startingPrice.qualifier: Basic plan, up to 40 Planning Center volunteers

tiers.label: Basic
tiers.detail: Up to 40 Planning Center volunteers; sermon matching, repertoire sync, rehearsal briefs and team resources.

tiers.label: Premium
tiers.detail: Unlimited Planning Center volunteers, multi-site support and priority support.

pricing.trialDetails: Supplier documents a 14-day Standard-tier trial without a payment card.

gdprInformation: The supplier describes itself as processor for church planning data synchronised from Planning Center and says its Google Cloud Firestore data is in the UK/EU (europe-west3). It says volunteer names, emails and contact details are not passed to Gemini, although anonymous musical metadata and sermon material can be processed for AI outputs. The supplier is a sole trader and an early product, so obtain its current ICO registration, processor agreement, security evidence, Gemini data terms and incident process before connecting live Planning Center data.
support: Premium plan describes dedicated support and a 24-hour response target

uk-operator.value: The supplier's terms and privacy material identify Chris Renshaw as a UK sole trader operating WorshipFlow AI.

planning-center-dependency.value: Supplier describes OAuth integration with Planning Center Services for repertoire, service and volunteer-planning information.

pricing.value: Supplier publishes GBP monthly plans at £12, £29 and £59 and a 14-day no-card trial.

data-handling.value: Supplier describes processor status, UK/EU Firestore storage, Planning Center OAuth and a stated rule that volunteer PII is not sent to Gemini.

editorial.assessment: WorshipFlow AI is an early, specialised add-on for a church already using Planning Center Services; it cannot stand alone for worship planning, people records or volunteer administration. Its published UK operation, clear GBP tiers and unusually detailed Planning Center data description make a controlled trial feasible. However, it is operated by a sole trader, uses AI processing and is presented as a new pilot-stage product, so the church should test accuracy, support and processor safeguards before authorising a live connection.
bestFor: Planning Center churches that want sermon-to-song suggestions without manually analysing a large repertoire
Worship leaders preparing singer-specific transposition and rehearsal notes
Teams able to run a controlled trial with non-sensitive planning data
strengths: Built specifically around Planning Center Services rather than generic text generation
Published GBP pricing and a 14-day no-card trial
Supplier documents its use of OAuth and data separation from Gemini
Supports UK Common Worship and Revised Common Lectionary context according to supplier documentation
limitations: Requires Planning Center Services and is not a replacement for it
Early pilot-stage product run by a sole trader
AI song, licensing and devotional suggestions require human theological and copyright review
Current DPA, ICO registration, support capacity and full processor evidence should be obtained directly

procurementVerdict.problem: Linking a weekly sermon theme, an existing Planning Center repertoire and the practical needs of a worship team
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK-operated, Planning Center-specific AI workflow that combines theme matching with roster-aware rehearsal briefs
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Connect a test Planning Center organisation, inspect requested permissions, run several previously planned services, compare recommendations with human decisions and obtain the current processor agreement before connecting live volunteer data
